column1: # Git hook gates that can be switched off. One row per gate, tab-separated:
# A persistable gate reads git config speckit.hooks.<key>; off, false, no or 0 in local or
# global config acts as if <env>=1 were set for that run. A non-persistable row is a per-push
# approval: it stays a one-command variable so every push gets a fresh decision.
# The hooks read this file through gate-config.sh and /doctor:git hooks reads it to list gates.

column5: Blocks ephemeral ids such as spec paths and task numbers in staged code comments
Blocks a commit whose runtime command, agent or prompt mirrors drift from .skilled
Blocks a staged CLI skill or prompt card that leaves the prompt-quality cards out of sync
Blocks a staged MCP doctor or install script that breaks its read-only or mutating label
Re-mints and stages compiled routing manifests when a hub's sources change
Re-mints and stages a spec folder's derived metadata when its docs change
Stamps the Commit-Id trailer and strips runtime attribution lines; commit-msg rules may require the trailer
Warns, never blocks, when a push carries stale skill-root metadata
Blocks a push whose compiled routing manifests are stale
Blocks a push whose spec track roots are inconsistent
Approval for one push to a branch outside the remote allowlist
Approval for one push that deletes more files than the mass-deletion threshold
